title: Toothbrush with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Handle -->
  <rect x="42" y="45" width="16" height="50" rx="8" fill="#3A8EDB"/>
  <!-- Handle highlight stripe -->
  <rect x="46" y="48" width="4" height="44" rx="2" fill="#6FB8F5"/>
  <!-- Handle grip lines -->
  <rect x="42" y="72" width="16" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#2A6DB5"/>
  <rect x="42" y="78" width="16" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#2A6DB5"/>
  <rect x="42" y="84" width="16" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#2A6DB5"/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x="44" y="28" width="12" height="20" rx="5" fill="#4A9DE8"/>
  <!-- Brush head -->
  <rect x="40" y="8" width="20" height="24" rx="9" fill="#5AAAF0"/>
  <!-- Brush head lighter top -->
  <rect x="43" y="10" width="14" height="8" rx="6" fill="#8CCBF8"/>
  <!-- Bristles -->
  <rect x="42" y="4" width="3" height="10" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="47" y="3" width="3" height="11" rx="1.5" fill="#F0F8FF"/>
  <rect x="52" y="4" width="3" height="10" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="57" y="5" width="3" height="9" rx="1.5" fill="#F0F8FF"/>
  <!-- Bristle tips -->
  <circle cx="43.5" cy="4" r="1.6" fill="#DFF0FF"/>
  <circle cx="48.5" cy="3" r="1.6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="53.5" cy="4" r="1.6" fill="#DFF0FF"/>
  <circle cx="58.5" cy="5" r="1.6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Face background on brush head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="19" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#3A8EDB"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="17" r="2.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="17" r="2.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="46.5" cy="17.3" r="1.1" fill="#1A3A5C"/>
  <circle cx="54.5" cy="17.3" r="1.1" fill="#1A3A5C"/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="45.8" cy="16.4" r="0.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="53.8" cy="16.4" r="0.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M45 21 Q50 25 55 21" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="43.5" cy="20.5" r="1.5" fill="#FF9EC4"/>
  <circle cx="56.5" cy="20.5" r="1.5" fill="#FF9EC4"/>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <path d="M32 14 L33.5 18 L32 22 L30.5 18 Z" fill="#FFE45C"/>
  <path d="M68 26 L69.3 29 L68 32 L66.7 29 Z" fill="#FFE45C"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="14" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="30" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
</svg>
